chapter: Le Ruban Bleu, retirement and community work
title: A rhythm-and-blues arrangement of 'Loch Lomond'
summary: She once recorded an r&b version for a tape that may not have been released.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: By the way did you tell me that you did a rhythm and blues selection of "Loch Lomond" at one time?

I don't know. Somebody came up with the idea. I think it was at the same time, you know, when I got mad at these people who asked me to do a rhythm and blues. Somebody came up with this idea of doing this version of "Loch Lomond".

I don't know really. Anyway we're down there and they have this arrangement. I don't know some popular arrangement had done it. All the guitars and bass, and this rock arrangement of "Loch Lomond". I recorded it.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

I have no idea whether it was issued or not. But I told them to keep the money. I was, you know, I'm not the kind to say, I won't do this. Sometimes I do some things and I'm sorry I did them. But I don't know whether they issued it or not but a friend of mine, in fact Alan Eichler who books some of the performers into Marty's, he's got a lot of stuff down there and he told me he had that, I don't know, a tape of that particular version and he sent it to me. And then at the same session I did a tune, I don't even remember what it was . . .
Needless to say this does not appear on your, in your jazz discography.

No, I don't know what happened. I don't know whether they released it or what. He probably had a friend and he was in the studio that day. I wouldn't know. There is a selection that I did a number, I guess, what do you call it, the Patti Page type thing, and I sing a duet with myself. I don't remember having made that.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
I don't remember. I don't remember.
Do you still have that tape?
